name: Sovereign Ground
description: Commissioned and distributed by Helion Dynamics corponation, this prestige holographic feature dramatizes the 'founding generation' of Helion's Tier 4 residential arcology as a story of visionary sacrifice and earned prosperity — framing corponation citizenship as the apex of human social evolution. The film was mandatory viewing in all Helion-territory schools for four years and was bundled free with every new Helion residency contract. Production values rival Vantablack blockbusters; it was made by Vantablack's Meridian Prestige subsidiary under a white-label deal.
cultural_impact: The phrase 'sovereign ground' became ironic shorthand in GLMZ for any narrative that justifies displacement as destiny, and the film's heroic theme music is routinely remixed in protest broadcasts.
story_hooks: The historian who was hired to authenticate the film's 'true story' framing has been missing for two years; her last message mentioned finding the actual relocation records.
A Helion executive's child, raised on this film, has hired the players to find evidence that it's true — because their parent's dying confession suggested it wasn't.

Someone is distributing a shot-for-shot remake of Sovereign Ground using actual archival footage of the 2189 the Gray Zone clearances cut into the exact same edit — it's indistinguishable until the third act.
